args.body: Hi Nessa, your landlord says the landing smoke alarm work was done on 31 August, and that he also tightened/secured some sockets and gave you a dehumidifier for the bathroom. We haven't confirmed this yet, so could you tell us: 1) Is a working smoke alarm now fitted on the landing, and has the ceiling hole gone? 2) Are any sockets still loose or coming away from the wall (any scorching, buzzing or warm sockets, please stop using them and tell us at once)? 3) Did you receive the dehumidifier, and is there any damp or mould in the bathroom? If there is no working alarm at the moment, please tell us today. We will review this with you by 10 September.
